$comment: Provider allowlist. One entry per upstream; `enabled: false` skips it. Keys come from .env (git-ignored), never from this file. `headers` carry SDK identity for providers that gate models behind it — omitting them makes working models answer 403. `freeSource` picks how zero-cost models are identified; providers differ and getting this wrong silently invents free models that 402 on first use.

providers.label: Hermes Proxy
providers.note: Local proxy. Ignores Authorization, so the default token is inert.

providers.label: Cline Pass
providers.note: The cline-free/* models return 403 without these four headers. Its /models endpoint carries no pricing, so the recommended-models free list is the only reliable free signal.

providers.label: Kilo
providers.note: Use this provider's live pricing, never OMP's cached cost: the cache marks ~200 paid models as free, and they answer 402.
